questions.explanation: f'=2e^{2x}, f''=4e^{2x}, so f''(0)=4. The tempting 2 uses f' value.

questions.subject: ALGEBRA_II
questions.learningObjective: Compute average cost
questions.stem: A ticket gives C(x)=100+4x; compute average cost at x=25.
questions.explanation: AC=C/x=(100+4x)/x=100/x+4=4+4=8. The tempting 4 ignores the fixed cost spread.

questions.subject: ALGEBRA_II
questions.learningObjective: Determine revenue-maximising price
questions.stem: A ticket asks when revenue is maximised with respect to price.

options.text: When |E| is infinite, perfectly elastic
When |E|=0, perfectly inelastic
When |E|=1, unit elasticity
When |E| is as small as possible

questions.explanation: Revenue R=pq; dR/dp=q(1+E). Setting to zero gives E=-1, i.e. |E|=1. The extremes do not maximise finite revenue.
questions.hint: Set derivative of revenue to zero.

questions.learningObjective: Evaluate a limit involving (x^2-1)/(x-1)
questions.stem: A ticket asks lim (x^2-1)/(x-1) as x->1; compute the value.
questions.explanation: Factor (x-1)(x+1)/(x-1)=x+1, so limit is 2. Direct substitution gives 0/0.

questions.subject: ALGEBRA_II
questions.learningObjective: Detect an incorrect power rule on a composite
questions.stem: A ticket shows d/dx[(2x)^3] = 3(2x)^2 written as 3*4x^2; check correctness.

options.text: Correct, 3*(2x)^2*2 = 24x^2? wait
The inner derivative 2 is missing
The exponent should drop to 2 without coefficient
The base 2x should be treated as constant

questions.explanation: d/dx[(2x)^3]=3(2x)^2*2=24x^2. Writing 3(2x)^2=12x^2 omits the inner derivative 2. Option A's text is muddled; B is the real flaw.

questions.learningObjective: Compute dy/dx for parametric trig
questions.stem: A ticket gives x=sin t, y=cos t; compute dy/dx at t=pi/4.
questions.explanation: dy/dx = -sin t / cos t = -tan t, so at pi/4 it is -1. The tempting 1 uses tan without the negative.

questions.subject: ALGEBRA_II
questions.learningObjective: Interpret marginal cost at zero production
questions.stem: A ticket gives C(x)=100+6x; explain C'(0).

answer.exemplar: C'(0)=6 dollars per unit, the cost of producing the first unit approximately; fixed cost 100 does not affect marginal cost.

questions.explanation: The derivative removes the constant fixed cost, so marginal cost is 6 regardless of x. The tempting 106 confuses total with marginal.

questions.subject: ALGEBRA_II
questions.learningObjective: Compute elasticity and classify
questions.stem: A ticket gives q=60-2p with p=5; first compute E, then classify demand.

options.text: E=-5, perfectly elastic
E=-2, elastic demand
E=-1/3, unit elastic
E=-1/5, inelastic demand

questions.explanation: q=50 at p=5, dq/dp=-2, E=(5/50)(-2)=-0.2=-1/5, inelastic. The other options drop or distort the p/q factor.
